thesis: Berkshire Hathaway is a insurance-led conglomerate with rail, energy and industrial units with ROE of 11.5% TTM on reported equity. Against the configured valuation grid the base fair value is 389.50 versus a 502.65 close (-22.5%), so the stock already prices in more than the filings support.

strengths.point: Durable low-cost insurance float and a decentralised operating model.
P/E of 12.5x on TTM earnings with ROE of 11.5% TTM on reported equity.

risks.point: Key risk: succession and the difficulty of deploying a very large cash pile.
Base fair value sits 22.5% below the last close.

invalidation_rationale: The fundamental kill condition is a business metric, not a price: a sustained decline in TTM operating income or a cut to capital returns would break the thesis.
conviction_reason: Quality is clear but the valuation grid gives no edge.
self_evidence_reason: TTM, FY history and the valuation grid were available from SEC companyfacts.
